description: Git 仓库操作（自 commands/git_cmds.rs 拆出，kernel-plugin-runtime P2-3）

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Get the current git status — branch name, ahead/behind count, and list of changed files with their status (modified, added, deleted, untracked).

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

tools.name: git_diff_unstaged
tools.description: Show the git diff for unstaged changes. Returns unified diff output. Use to review changes before staging/committing.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

file.description: Optional: specific file to diff. If omitted, shows all unstaged changes.

staged.description: Set to true to show staged changes instead of unstaged

tools.name: git_diff_staged
tools.description: Show the git diff for unstaged changes. Returns unified diff output. Use to review changes before staging/committing.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

file.description: Optional: specific file to diff. If omitted, shows all unstaged changes.

staged.description: Set to true to show staged changes instead of unstaged

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Show recent git commit history. Returns structured JSON with commit hash, message, author, and date for each commit.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

count.description: Number of recent commits to show (default: 10)

tools.name: git_stage
tools.description: Stage files for commit. Use before git_commit to add changes to the staging area.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

files.description: File path(s) to stage, separated by commas. Use "." to stage all.

tools.name: git_stage_all
tools.description: Stage all changes (including untracked files) for commit. Equivalent of `git add .`.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Commit staged changes with a message. Files must be staged first with git_stage. Returns the commit hash.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

_forceGate.description: Bypass the architecture gate for HIGH-risk writes. Set to true only after confirming safety via trace_impact.

tools.name: git_push
tools.description: Push committed changes to the remote repository.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

tools.name: git_pull
tools.description: Pull latest changes from the remote repository (fast-forward only, no merge conflicts).

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

tools.name: git_init
tools.description: Initialize a new git repository in the given directory.

tools.name: git_checkout
tools.description: Switch to a different branch. Use git_create_branch first if the branch does not exist.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository

_forceGate.description: Bypass the architecture gate for HIGH-risk writes. Set to true only after confirming safety via trace_impact.

tools.name: git_create_branch
tools.description: Create a new git branch from the current HEAD. Does NOT switch to it — use git_checkout after.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository

tools.name: git_stash_push
tools.description: Stash current uncommitted changes. Use before switching branches with dirty working tree.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository

tools.name: git_stash_pop
tools.description: Restore the most recently stashed changes. Pops the stash — the changes are applied and the stash entry is removed.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository

tools.name: git_discard
tools.description: Discard unstaged changes to a file (git checkout -- <file>). Loses all uncommitted modifications.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository

file.description: File path to discard changes for (relative to repo root)

_forceGate.description: Bypass the architecture gate for HIGH-risk writes. Set to true only after confirming safety via trace_impact.

tools.name: git_blame
tools.description: Show who last modified each line of a file (git blame). Output is porcelain-format and truncated for very large results.

path.description: Absolute path to the git repository root

file.description: File to blame (relative to the repository root)
